CA.rationale: Candidate/inherited_current origin metadata is explicitly linked to the candidate content coordinates.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates and separate origin metadata provide explicit content (C), organization/access (O) and a distinct status/origin (D) for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Candidate/inherited_current origin metadata explicitly links a processing condition to the same content's representation.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries list coordinates paired with color attributes in current records.

D.rationale: Coordinates (content) and separate origin/status metadata are provided for the same referents, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: Presentation/organization is given both as display orientation and record-origin metadata describing how contents are organized/accessed.
